title: Smoky Eastern-Style Haddock-Free Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry inspired by the Middle East, made with haddock-free alternatives and smoky spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika and garam masala. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the curry powder and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the roasted cauliflower and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
